items.textToSpeech: For the European Union, Dietary Reference Values are published by the European Food Safety Authority Panel on Dietetic Products, Nutrition and Allergies. The Panel concludes that no Population Reference Intake for chromium for the performance of physiological functions can be defined.

However, I can tell you that chromium contributes to normal macronutrient metabolism and contributes to the maintenance of normal blood glucose levels. The European Commission has authorised these claims for products which contain at least 6 micrograms of chromium per 100 grams, per 100 millilitres or per package, if the package contains only a single portion. Is there anything else I can help you with?
